findings.title: Table Structure
findings.evidence: No <th> or <caption> tags found in tabular data.

suggested_action.summary: Use complete HTML table markup (<th>, <thead>) instead of CSS grids for tabular data to ensure machine parsers can map columns correctly.

findings.title: Fluff Density

Add <th> elements to tables to provide semantic context for data cells.
